resources.string: Features
What this TV runs. Each is switched on or off in its own section; a feature that is off never starts.
Everything but Phone notes and Phone remote starts on. Each is set up on its own row below, where you can also switch it on or off; one not set up when you finish is switched off.
A pushed config.json can set these too (\"features\").

Titles, artwork, your lists and search come from TMDB, a free film and TV database. TMDB account is switched off on this TV: Turn on switches it on and signs in. Apps, inputs and the clock on Home work without it.
Titles, artwork, your lists and search come from TMDB, a free film and TV database. Sign in once with your phone in Launcher settings › Account. Apps, inputs and the clock on Home work without it.

%1$s needs a TMDB key

Titles, artwork and search come from TMDB, a free film and TV database, which needs a free key from this household. Add it once from a phone or laptop in Launcher settings \u203a API keys. Apps, inputs and the clock on Home work without it.
